tools.name: earthquakes_recent
tools.description: Latest earthquakes worldwide from the USGS feed (updated every minute). Filter by minimum magnitude and time window; sorted newest first or by magnitude.

tools.name: earthquakes_near
tools.description: Earthquakes within a radius of a latitude/longitude, from the USGS feed, nearest first data includes distance_km.

tools.name: earthquake_detail
tools.description: One earthquake by USGS event id (e.g. us7000abcd): magnitude, depth, felt reports, intensity, PAGER alert, tsunami flag and a plain-English summary.

tools.name: airport_lookup
tools.description: Full record for one airport by IATA (DEL), ICAO (VIDP) or local code: name, location, elevation, time zone, runways, radio frequencies, nearby airports and cities. Source: OurAirports (public domain). Not for navigation.

tools.name: airport_search
tools.description: Find airports with an IATA or ICAO code by name, city or code, optionally within one country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Largest airports first.

tools.name: airports_nearest
tools.description: Airports with an IATA code or scheduled service nearest a latitude/longitude, with distance and direction.

tools.name: flight_distance
tools.description: Great-circle distance (km, miles, nautical miles), initial heading and a rough flight time between two airports.

tools.name: city_time
tools.description: Current local time, time zone, UTC offset, daylight saving changes and today's sunrise/sunset for a city (any place with 15,000+ people, GeoNames). Accepts a name like 'Pune' or a slug like 'pune-in'.

tools.name: time_difference
tools.description: Time difference right now between two cities or IANA time zones, with both local times.

tools.name: sun_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, twilight and golden hour for coordinates and a date (default today), in local time and UTC.

tools.name: country_info
tools.description: ISO 3166 codes, capital, population, area, currency, dialling code, languages, neighbours, time zones and largest cities for a country (ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name).

tools.name: aircraft_lookup
tools.description: Look up a US-registered aircraft on the FAA registry by N-number (e.g. N12345) or 6-character Mode S hex code (e.g. A0B1C2): make, model, year, engine, seats, registration status and dates, airworthiness class and transponder code. Owner name is given for organisations only; individuals are never na

tools.name: zip_lookup
tools.description: Details for a US ZIP code: city, state, county, coordinates, time zone, land area, and Census ACS 5-year figures (population, median age, median household income, home value, rent, education, poverty) with state comparisons, plus nearby ZIPs and airports.

tools.name: zip_search
tools.description: ZIP codes whose post-office name matches a US city, optionally within a state (2-letter code), largest population first.

tools.name: zips_near
tools.description: Nearest US ZIP codes to a latitude/longitude, by distance from each ZIP's centre.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zip_search · Private data: airport_lookup · Public sink: zip_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zip_search · Private data: airport_lookup · Public sink: zip_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
